articles.summary: Tiziana announced that the last patient has begun dosing in its Phase 2 clinical trial evaluating intranasal foralumab in patients with early/mild Alzheimer’s disease (AD). Topline data are anticipated to be announced in Q1 2027.
articles.title: Tiziana Doses Last Patient in Phase 2 Trial of Intranasal Foralumab for Mild Alzheimer’s Disease
